title: A tongue reaches out
hook: The prey need not be next to a frog’s mouth.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The drawing shows a tongue extending from the frog toward an insect. Frog tongue mechanics vary, and the simplified path does not show muscle motion or measure the capture.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In the illustrated capture, which structure extends toward the insect?
